arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Gant argued the case involves the Court and Congress. He emphasized the FDCPA context.
Mr. Bond stated the Third Circuit decided the discovery rule question. He focused on the specific legal issue.
Mr. Dvoretzky argued Congress set the start date. He claimed the clock begins at the violation.

sections.heading: What each side wants
paragraphs: the sides that brought the case want a discovery rule for the FDCPA. They argue the clock starts when the violation is discovered.

the opposing sides argue the FDCPA text sets the start date. They claim the clock begins when the violation occurs.

sections.heading: What the justices asked
paragraphs: Justice Kavanaugh asked if the discovery rule is equitable. He questioned if common law discovery equals equitable discovery.
Justice Sotomayor asked if the sides that brought the case create a fourth equitable doctrine. She referenced equitable tolling and estoppel.
